blocks.title: An override with a different signature
blocks.source:
Class Base
  Method Saludo() As String
    Return "hola";
  EndMethod
EndClass

Class Hija Inherits From Base
  Method Saludo(nombre As String) As String
    Return "hola " + nombre;
  EndMethod
EndClass

Algorithm Mal
EndAlgorithm
